us: DSR-587/654/586 og:image retest · DSR-529 TC-011 re-baseline · isActive OFF browser redirect · DSR-654/570 catalog -form rerun

parts.1_og_image: 52 page×tier from manifest REPUBLISH-OVL-20261022: 42 full pass (og:image + twitter:image absolute, GET 200 image/*), 9 unavailable pages with site-default og:image = expected, 1 preview-only skip on .live; 0 about:error. VOV-003 ja/en pass both tiers; MOVIE-029 pass both tiers; CATOV-002 og:image assertion pass; PDO-003 TD-586-01 blocked (unavailable | no-product / en 404), pass on product 46 (.page, PDO_ID).
parts.2_article_011: Re-baselined (spec + docs/DSR-529 A16 + tc-out 11.0, source Martin 22/10 DSR-659 c.64884). ja+en pass on both tiers; listing card part blocked (no article listing with qa529 cards on DEV).
parts.3_isactive_off: qa654-inactive ja/en both tiers: raw 200 + unavailable | inactive + noindex, browser final URL = /{lang}/library/catalog, list HTTP 200 (browser navigation). qa587-inactive 404 (not seeded) → blocked. qa587-off (movie-unavailable) → /en/library/video/search 200. Existing inactive TCs assert browser final URL (no HTTP 30x) → no TC text change.
parts.4_catalog_form: Preflight requiresForm=true on 4 -form pages × 2 tiers. CATOV-016, CATDL-006 ja/en, CATDL-010 ja pass both tiers; CATOV-001 non-form pass; CATOV-001 -form fail (data, TD-190 title); CATOV-002 non-form fail (noindex / requiresForm row, 40%, known JOB-14); CATOV-018 pending (A5).
